newsitem.title: USA: AMR, BA exploring summer pacts - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AMR, BA exploring summer pacts - WSJ.

text.p: American Airlines and British Airways have been spurred into talks on possible summer pacts by potential obstacles to an open-skies pact between the United States and Britain, although the pact is nearly complete, the Wall Street Journal said on Wednesday.
The paper said people familiar with the talks say the two airlines are exploring ways to implement shared frequent-flier arrangements and computerised reservation links during the summer.

The airlines hoped an open-skies agreement would permit their alliance to begin April 1, but the paper said the pact must still clear roadblocks in the United States, Britain and the European Union, making it unlikely that any alliance could take effect before the targeted date.
